info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Kestrel Drill Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Kestrel Drill Detail API enables users to submit detailed information about Kestrel drill products to the catalog. This endpoint facilitates the addition of new drill specifications, enhancing the visibility and availability of drilling equipment information for users. Typical consumers include product managers and inventory specialists who need to maintain comprehensive product data. This API plays a critical role in ensuring accurate and up-to-date catalog entries, supporting better decision-making and resource allocation.

post.summary: Create details for a Kestrel drill.
post.description: This operation allows you to create detailed information about a Kestrel drill. Ensure that all required fields are provided in the request body for successful creation.
